instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rotary_flute.step. Create a rotary contour or equivalent multi-axis toolpath for the cylindrical flute part. Use the X-axis cylinder setup, post rotary motion as the A axis, and machine four helical flute paths along the 120 mm part length. Tool definition: T1 is the rotary contour tool used to cut the four helical flutes with posted A-axis rotary motion. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-19.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
